blocks.text: Burnaby Lake homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Burnaby Lake, September 2026. Detached houses: 19 listed at month end and 2 sold in September, a sales ratio of 11% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 3 listed at month end and 1 sold in September, a sales ratio of 33%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, detached houses sold 6 over 4 months against an average of 21.0 listed, about 14.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 2 sold. condos and townhomes sold 4 over 4 months against an average of 4.2 listed, about 4.2 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was August with 2 sold.
